reviews.author: Lisa Bishop
reviews.text: This is a great campground. The spots are fairly private with good spacing between them. The campground is mostly forested with a few spots of sun here and there. The lake is beautiful and has a swimming area. There are trails all around the campground. The bathrooms are clean. It can be a bit noisy as it's close to the highway.

reviews.author: Sally P
reviews.text: If extreme sports aren't enough for you any more. Come try extreme travel trailer driving at this park. Start off with the bridges, make sure to bring your mirrors in. Then navigate the tight turns and narrow roads. Overall a beautiful park with great hiking trails. Cranberry Lake is nice for swimming. Sites are well maintained.

reviews.author: Misha Smith
reviews.text: We recently visited Cranberry Lake and had a great experience, even though it was raining when we arrived. It made settling into our site a bit tricky, but the campground itself is beautiful. The lake is stunning, and there's a nice beach area for swimming. The trails nearby are excellent for hiking. Staff was friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Karen Powers
reviews.text: Noisy but beautiful campground. The miles of trails surrounding the camp are lovely. Campground sites are generally very private due to the numerous trees and shrubs. The lake is great for kayaking and swimming. Close to the bridge for amazing views. Navy jets can be loud during the day.

reviews.author: Greg Taylor
reviews.text: Had a great spot. Close to the beach and several hiking trails.

reviews.author: Tammy French
reviews.text: Beautiful campground. I stayed in a cabin across from the pond. The campground was quiet despite being close to the highway. The campground is located across the highway from the southern end of the park. The cabins are nice and clean. The pond is peaceful and great for bird watching.

reviews.author: Samantha Inks
reviews.text: Most sites are good sized with shrubs and trees for privacy. Overall, the sites seem to be mostly level and many have space for tents. I found these sites easier for backing a trailer in when compared to Cranberry Lake. Full hookups available. Close to a mini mart.

reviews.author: Renée Hardiman
reviews.text: Clean and easy campground near beaches. When we were there, there were no Navy jets operating at night. The water spigots are turned off in the winter. The bathrooms are heated (that was very welcome in February). Sites have full hookups. Some road noise from Hwy 20 but not terrible.

reviews.author: Katelyn Payo
reviews.text: Campground is well-maintained and people are very respectful. Campsites can be close together, but pits and picnic benches are usually separate for some privacy.

reviews.author: Brent Knobel
reviews.text: Awesome camp ground. Some spots are really sloped. Making it hard to level an rv. Other than that cool quiet place with a bit to explore. There is a mini mart close by with a lot of the things you might need.

reviews.author: Nash Kosumi
reviews.text: We came here for a more relaxed afternoon away from the main bridge traffic, and it was the highlight of our visit. The bay is much calmer and has a great stretch of shoreline where you can just sit and enjoy the view. Saw harbor seals on the rocks. Great for families with kids - calm water, tide pools nearby.

reviews.author: JoyBird
reviews.text: One of my favorite places on earth... There's so many cool spots to explore from there & walk/hike to. Like beaches. And island like areas with wild rabbits & thrilling high cliff edges dropping down to the water. The camping area is small but beautiful with water and clean bathrooms.

reviews.author: Michael Hyde
reviews.text: Great place to relax on shore or take to the water! Look for harbor seals on shore!

reviews.author: Madeline Gottemoeller
reviews.text: Clean. Nice camping areas. Water and clean bathrooms. Hiked from Bowman to Lottie Point loop. Walked through green kelp on part of the beach. All in all, a lovely walk. Two little kids and two grandmas had a great time.

reviews.author: Zach Szablewski
reviews.text: This is a great section of Deception Pass State Park. It is a coast section on the north end of the park. There is a rocky beach and long dock. There is a trail to Rosario Head and a camping area. The views are spectacular.
